scoring_justification: Structural parameters are self-reported from a fit to total-energy data not submitted; band gaps and phonon frequencies are recomputed from raw eigenvalue/frequency arrays, enabling recompute checks for those stages.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold structural parameters (lattice constant, bulk modulus, pressure derivative) from paper Table
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reported values in table (Present row)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's explicitly reported values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold band gap values (indirect and direct) estimated from Fig. 2
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Graphical extraction from Fig. 2 of paper; approximate due to no explicit numerical values given
hidden_assets.generation_method: Estimated band edges from band structure plot yielding indirect gap ~0.8 eV, direct gap at Γ ~1.2 eV.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Reasonable estimate from the paper's figure; tolerances large enough to accommodate estimation uncertainty and toolchain spread.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold phonon frequencies at high-symmetry points Γ, X, W, L estimated from Fig. 3
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Approximate values read from phonon dispersion plot Fig.3; tolerance of 1 THz allows for re-run variation.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Approximate reading of acoustic and optical branch frequencies at Γ, X, W, L from the published figure.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are derived directly from the paper's figure, not invented; tolerances absorb estimation imprecision.

outputs.description: Equilibrium structural parameters extracted from the total-energy equation of state fit.
Electronic band energies along high-symmetry k-points. The array contains one object per k-point with its coordinates and a list of band eigenvalues.
Phonon frequencies along high-symmetry q-points. The array contains one object per q-point with its coordinates and a list of phonon mode frequencies.

output_contract.notes: Scoring compares the equilibrium lattice constant, bulk modulus, pressure derivative, selected band gaps, and phonon frequencies at high-symmetry points against hidden reference values with tolerances that accommodate typical toolchain variations (pseudopotential choice, convergence settings). No explicit gold values or tolerances are revealed to the solver.
